description: Evidence-type vocabulary for Admissibility & Foundation Gaps (PRD v4.0 §7.5). Data, not code. A type is PROPOSED from the words in an evidence item's label, kind and document name; counsel confirms or changes it. 'keywords' are matched case-insensitively on word boundaries; the type with most distinct keyword hits wins, ties go to the earlier type. The names here are the 'evidence_type' values ADMISSIBILITY_REQUIREMENT rows refer to.
